motif: A cracked-glaze, upturned eave band trimmed in Laca Imperial pink (#E84D8E), set over a knee-deep oil-mud base on every building.

buildings.why: Low timber hall open across the whole front. The long, flat roofline is its silhouette.
A standing barrel with a basket roof. It reads as a plain drum.

buildings.colour: dark gunmetal iron grey with green-patina copper seams
buildings.why: Tall stack with a glass orb on top. It is the tallest thin shape in the race.

buildings.colour: bleached off-white canvas and pale timber
buildings.why: A timber arch with the balloon hanging in it. The hole through the middle is the silhouette.
Brew Hut chain keeps the drum. The slumped second floor and leaning counter widen and tilt the top. Grey separates it from the oak original and from its neighbours.
A cracked jar with the crack as the door. The broken rim gives a hollow crown.

buildings.colour: rust terracotta red with dull zinc
buildings.why: A crooked zinc roof on posts over an open bench. It reads as a span on legs.
A keg stalk with a canvas platform box on top. It differs from the red Workshop beside it.

buildings.colour: ochre tarpaulin canvas with a black chimney
buildings.why: Dojo chain, shorter and wider, closed by tarps. The furnace chimney through the roof marks the upgrade.

buildings.colour: slate-grey kegs with chipped glazed eaves
buildings.why: Tavern chain grows the drum into a circular stack of kegs under a pagoda. It is the tallest, widest drum in the race.

buildings.colour: patched coppery brass over soot-dark brick
buildings.why: A squat still house with a copper alembic dome. Its warm metal tone is unlike the neighbouring greys and greens.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.colour: pale living-bamboo green with a canvas kite
buildings.why: A mast, a kite and a lightning rod make a cluster of thin peaks. The green is lighter than the Jade Shrine's.

buildings.colour: deep crimson lacquer with china-white showcase panels
buildings.why: A pawnshop of piled goods with a showcase front and a smoking furnace behind. Stepped, stacked blocks set it apart from the other halls.
